descriptor: Project plan drawn as a metro map

voice.summary: Harbour Library Redesign writes like a well-run project office with a map habit. It names milestones as stations, workstreams as lines and keeps updates short and dated.
dos: Name each milestone as a station with a date
Say which line a task belongs to
donts: Do not use project jargon like leverage

taglines: Plan the project like a metro
Follow the line to opening day
boilerplate: Harbour Library Redesign is a project plan drawn as a transit map, with coloured lines for discovery, design and build and stations for each shared milestone.
